gloss: root cause, chief culprit, main offender

definitions.gloss: root cause, chief culprit, main offender
definitions.explanation: The primary source of a problem or the person most responsible for causing harm. Carries a strongly negative connotation.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{元凶|げんきょう}を{探|さが}す。
examples.english: Look for the root cause of the problem.

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}の{元凶|げんきょう}は{工事|こうじ}だった。
examples.english: The main cause of the traffic jam was road construction.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{不正|ふせい}の{元凶|げんきょう}となった{人物|じんぶつ}がようやく{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: The person who was the chief culprit behind years of fraud was finally arrested.

notes:
Can refer to both a person (the culprit) and a thing (the root cause). Always used negatively — it implies blame and responsibility for a bad outcome.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{元凶|げんきょう}を{突|つ}き{止|と}める (identify the root cause)
・{問題|もんだい}の{元凶|げんきょう} (root cause of the problem)
・{諸悪|しょあく}の{元凶|げんきょう} (the source of all evils)
